answer: Each identity files one ocean chart and locks a 70-credit bond. Its spiral transect surveys one sector under its own key. Auditors recompute the sector from the public table; any nonzero delta burns the bond. Filing 45, k-th 45+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Rented or copied charts fail: the track is key-bound to its maker, so reuse burns both bonds. An honest agent files once, pays 45, keeps the bond.
